THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Export demand and domestic financing出口需求与国内融资

Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。

Export earnings, the won and domestic financing conditions connect the economy to equities.出口利润、韩元与国内融资条件将经济变化传导至股市。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

How the outlook could change前景可能如何变化

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。

CENTRAL BANK ASSESSMENT央行研判

The Bank of Korea describes support from exports, investment and recovering consumption. Inflation and housing-related credit pressures keep further rate increases in view.韩国央行指出出口、投资与消费复苏支持经济。通胀与住房相关信贷压力，使进一步加息仍在考虑范围内。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Energy costs versus household income能源成本与家庭收入

Energy imports reduce purchasing power when prices rise faster than household income. The Bank of Japan sees wage gains and fiscal measures cushioning that pressure.能源价格涨幅超过家庭收入时，进口能源会削弱购买力。日本央行认为工资增长与财政措施有助于缓冲压力。

A stronger yen improves unhedged dollar translation but can reduce overseas earnings in yen.日元升值改善未对冲的美元换算收益，但可能压低海外利润的日元计价。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

How the outlook could change前景可能如何变化

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If energy costs ease while wage gains hold, real incomes and household spending could improve; broader demand would support domestic-facing earnings.若能源成本下降且工资增长持续，实际收入与家庭支出可能改善，更广泛的需求将支持内需型企业利润。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If energy and import costs stay high, they could absorb wage gains and constrain consumption even with strong technology demand.若能源与进口成本持续偏高，可能抵消工资增长并限制消费，即使科技需求仍强。

CENTRAL BANK ASSESSMENT央行研判

The Bank of Japan expects higher energy costs to weigh on activity in fiscal 2026. Wage gains, government support and AI demand provide offsets; easing energy pressure and stronger income-to-spending transmission underpin its later pickup.日本央行预计能源成本上升拖累2026财年经济。工资增长、政府支持与AI需求提供缓冲；能源压力缓解、收入更有效地转化为支出，构成后续增长改善的基础。

Bank of Japan ↗ · 2026-07-31

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Real wages, household spending, energy import costs and the next Bank of Japan outlook.实际工资、家庭支出、能源进口成本与下一份日本央行展望。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Energy pass-through versus labour demand能源价格传导与劳动需求

The key tension is whether energy costs spread into wage and service prices before softer employment weakens demand.关键在于能源成本是否会在就业走软削弱需求之前，先传导至工资与服务价格。

Lower financing costs can support domestic demand; sterling also changes overseas earnings translation.融资成本下降可支持内需，英镑也会改变海外利润的换算。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

How the outlook could change前景可能如何变化

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If later MPC evidence finds energy pass-through contained while labour conditions stabilise, the case for further restraint would weaken.若后续央行证据显示能源价格传导受控且劳动市场企稳，进一步紧缩的必要性将减弱。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If wage and service-price persistence increases while employment weakens, policy would face a more difficult growth–inflation trade-off.若工资与服务价格的持续性增强，同时就业走弱，政策将面临更棘手的增长与通胀权衡。

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Private-sector pay, services prices, employment and the next MPC assessment of second-round effects.私营部门工资、服务价格、就业及央行下一次对第二轮效应的评估。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Energy, real incomes and public investment能源、实际收入与公共投资

Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。

Import costs affect real incomes; bank lending conditions transmit policy into investment and consumption.进口成本影响实际收入，银行信贷条件将政策传导至投资与消费。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

How the outlook could change前景可能如何变化

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。

CENTRAL BANK ASSESSMENT央行研判

The ECB’s September assessment finds the economy more resilient than expected. Its baseline relies on the energy shock fading, real incomes recovering and infrastructure and defence spending supporting demand; persistent export competitiveness problems remain a constraint.欧洲央行9月研判认为经济韧性强于预期。其基准情景依赖能源冲击消退、实际收入恢复，以及基建与国防支出支持需求；出口竞争力问题仍构成限制。

European Central Bank ↗ · 2026-09-10

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。

FOLLOW THE MECHANISM追踪传导机制

Global connections全球关联

Channels to examine, not causal estimates用于研究的渠道，并非因果估计
01 / DEMAND需求

Technology to exports科技传导至出口

Investment demand flows into export orders, production and earnings. Follow whether that strength spreads into domestic activity.投资需求传导至出口订单、生产与利润。关注这股力量能否扩散至国内经济。

Taiwan台湾 ↗South Korea韩国 ↗
02 / PRICES价格

Energy to real incomes能源传导至实际收入

Higher import costs can squeeze households and margins. Inflation then changes the room available for monetary support.进口成本上升可能挤压家庭购买力与利润率。通胀继而改变货币政策的支持空间。

Japan日本 ↗India印度 ↗Euro Area欧元区 ↗
03 / FINANCING融资

Policy to spending政策传导至支出

Policy reaches the economy through borrowing, saving and exchange rates. A lower rate is useful only if transmission follows.政策通过借贷、储蓄与汇率影响经济。利率下降的作用，取决于后续传导。

United Kingdom英国 ↗Australia澳大利亚 ↗
